Drive portfolio governance, shape portfolio management and act as Business Product Owner for Ambu’s project and portfolio management system, XPM.

Ambu A/S is looking for a Project Portfolio Management Specialist to join the Innovation PMO in Ballerup, Denmark.

Reporting to the Director, Innovation PMO, you will play a key role in strengthening how Ambu prioritizes, plans and governs its product development portfolio. You will drive portfolio governance, act as Business Product Owner for Ambu’s project and portfolio management platform (XPM), and translate insights from across R&D into system and process improvements that support better decision-making, portfolio transparency and execution.

Working with Project Managers, Line Managers, Finance and IT, you will connect decisions on product development projects and resources with how projects are planned, prioritized, and followed up.

You will join an Innovation PMO working across portfolio governance, planning, systems and process improvements. Together with colleagues responsible for other PMO systems and processes, you will help evolve how portfolio management is supported across R&D, ensuring governance, systems and planning processes continue to meet the needs of a growing organization.

The role offers the opportunity to deepen your experience in portfolio governance, business-system product ownership and cross-functional improvement, while working closely with stakeholders ranging from project teams and functional managers to senior leadership.

**Key Responsibilities

****Portfolio Governance

**

• Drive portfolio governance through Solution Steering Committee and Gate meetings, ensuring high-quality decision material, clear prioritization and effective follow-through on decisions

• Review and challenge project change requests and business cases, ensuring robust decision material and alignment with key stakeholders before submission

**Business Product Owner, XPM

**

• Own the XPM development and maintenance backlog; prioritize requirements from project managers, line managers, portfolio management and Finance

• Align updates with IT requirements and drive delivery through the IT system owner and XPM vendor

• Train R&D users, maintain XPM guidance and align XPM use with Product Owners of other PMO systems

**Cross-Functional Planning & Continuous Improvement

**

• Facilitate quarterly cross-functional planning, resource alignment and project forecasting; record decisions, action owners and deadlines.

• Onboard project managers and line managers on portfolio governance, submission requirements, approval mandates and escalation routes.

• Identify recurring decision-preparation, planning and follow-up issues; agree and implement improvements with process owners.

**Your Experience And Skills

**You are likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Have 5+ years of experience in project management, PMO, portfolio governance, project portfolio management or a related field

• Have experience translating business needs into system requirements and supported testing and implementation

• Have facilitated cross-functional planning and resource alignment and financial forecasting discussions

• Have worked closely with business stakeholders, IT teams and/or system vendors

• Can challenge incomplete decision material, secure follow-up across functions and communicate clearly in English

• Have a curious and proactive mindset, with the ability to identify improvement opportunities and translate insights into practical solutions

Experience with business-system product ownership, XPM or comparable PPM systems, and MedTech or another regulated industry is an advantage.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Welltec is looking for a motivated Accounting Assistant to become part of our dynamic HQ accounting team based in Allerød.

A world-class company

Welltec® is an international oilfield service company and a leading specialist partner to the energy industry.

Our values are to be Pioneering, Visionary, Dedicated, and Agile.

We develop and manufacture precision-controlled technologies which provide the most unique and advanced Completion and Intervention solutions, which assist our clients in maximizing recovery from their assets.

We always look to the future, utilizing our intelligence, imagination and expertise to create new opportunities. We have won several industry awards for innovative thinking. We are enjoying constant growth worldwide through the wide adoption of our cutting-edge solutions.

Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we are active and train our employees to operate our state-of-the-art technologies to provide services to our high-profile clients in the region.

The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employees come with very different backgrounds but with a common wish to collaborate and succeed.

The department

Welltec is looking for a motivated Accounting Assistant to become part of our dynamic HQ accounting team based in Allerød. Our HQ accounting team comprises 10 talented professionals from diverse backgrounds and nationalities, fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment.

In addition to accounting, the finance department is structured into four other specialized teams: Financial Planning & Analysis, Group Reporting, Treasury, and Tax. Together, these teams work cohesively to support the organization’s financial health and strategic objectives.

The position

You will be actively involved in the daily operational tasks and have a portfolio of own responsibilities. This blend of responsibilities will ensure a dynamic and enriching work experience.

Key responsibilities

• Input, update, and verify data in accounting systems with attention to detail

• Process and control travel expenses and export/import in ERP-systems

• Perform bank, account, and ledger reconciliations to ensure accuracy

• Monitor shared mailboxes

• Assist in identifying and resolving discrepancies in financial records

• Maintain approval flows in systems

• Participate in optimization projects

• Supporting team members whenever deemed relevant

The candidate

We’re looking for someone who has a strong sense of ownership, is service minded and a team player and have a positive attitude, are curious and eager to investigate and broaden the horizon and a good communicator.

We imagine that you:

• Have a track record within similar work +2 years

• If you have a relevant basic-level education, e.g. finalised trainee within accounting and economics (Økonomielev) this will be a plus

• Basic accounting skills, eg. debet/credit and chart of accounts

•  IT application skills, including MS Office, ERP-systems, vendor invoice processing systems and expense systems

• Speak and write English fluently and understanding Danish is an advantage

• Work in a structured way, with the necessary attention to details

• Adhere to deadlines while keeping an overview

•  Have inherent high business ethics

• Have a forthcoming personality and are a good team mate

Within 1 month you will:

• Settle in and get to know your new colleagues in the HQ Finance department located in Allerød

• Get introduced to the tasks and start learning the processes

Within 3 months you will:

• Run daily tasks independently

• Start building knowledge about maintaining the systems

• Start learning about the business set-up and finance processes

Within 9 months you will:

• Be experienced within the daily processes

• Participate actively in optimization processes

• Keep broaden the horizon within the company and global environment

What we offer

Working with Welltec® means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting and rewarding, and it is a varied place to work. The conference floor is where deals start. The dinner is where trust is built. The clip is what 10,000 people see the next morning. Own all three.

**About The Job

**GetWhy is the end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform trusted by the world’s most influential brands, including eBay, Arla, Warner Brothers and The Coca Cola company, to understand their customers at scale. We’re backed by $40M in Series A funding and scaling aggressively into the enterprise market.

In our category, events aren’t a nice-to-have. They are a strategic weapon. Industry conferences, hosted experiences, executive dinners and brand activations are where relationships form, pipeline is built, and GetWhy cements its position as the category leader in AI-powered qualitative research.

We’re hiring our first Lead, Global Events & Community to own how GetWhy shows up in the world. This is a high-ownership role for someone with taste, commercial instinct and relentless execution. You’ll design experiences enterprise buyers actually want to attend, turn every event into content that travels far beyond the room, and build the playbook that lets GetWhy show up brilliantly on every continent.

What you’ll do

Own the global event strategy

• Set GetWhy’s global events strategy with the marketing leadership, from tentpole industry conferences (IIEX, ESOMAR, Quirk’s) to hosted events, executive roundtables and product showcases.

• Plan, produce and execute 15–20+ events per year across Europe, the US and beyond, each tied to clear pipeline, brand and customer goals.

• Own the global events budget, sponsorship negotiations, and relationships with agencies, venues and production partners.

Make GetWhy unmissable at every conference

• Have a strong point of view on world-class conference presence, from booth concept and spatial design to merch and the small details people remember.

• Replace badge-scanning booths with live experiences: let attendees run a real GetWhy study, see AI-moderated interviews in action, and leave with an insight.

• Secure speaking slots and sponsorships that put GetWhy at the centre of the industry conversation.

Put customers on stage

• Build a flagship GetWhy-hosted event where customers present the work they’ve done with GetWhy and show other brands how to do the same.

• Recruit and prepare customer and executive speakers, and make sure every GetWhy representative on stage or on the floor is briefed and on message.

Own the side events and intimate moments

• Design VIP dinners, executive roundtables and side events around major conferences, where the real relationships are built.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success on account-based events that move specific deals and expansions forward.

Run the content machine

• Capture on-site content at every event, including video, photos and short clips that show GetWhy’s presence on the ground.

• Turn events into social media content, such as live posts, recaps, reels and LinkedIn stories, working with the wider marketing team.

• Conduct on-site interviews with customers, speakers and industry leaders, creating content for social, the website and sales enablement.

• Make sure every event keeps working for weeks afterwards through recaps, clips and follow-up campaigns.

Turn events into revenue

• Build the pre- and post-event engine: invitations, promotion, lead capture, qualification and a seamless handoff to Sales.

• Track and report on pipeline, ROI, reach and brand impact for every event, and double down on what works.

Build the playbook

• Create scalable playbooks and “event in a box” toolkits so local teams and partners can host on-brand GetWhy events anywhere.

• Grow the events function over time, including freelancers, agencies and future hires.

• Stay ahead of new event formats and technologies, and bring the best of them to GetWhy first.

Who you are

You’re not looking for an event coordination role. You’re a builder who sees events as the highest-leverage channel in a B2B enterprise sale, and you want to prove it on a global stage.

• 3–6+ years in event marketing, field marketing or experiential marketing for B2B SaaS, enterprise tech or a high-growth scale-up.

• A portfolio of standout events, with a track record that ties them directly to pipeline and revenue.

• Real taste. You know what makes a booth, a dinner or a keynote memorable, and you can explain why.

• Commercially minded. You think about pipeline and impact, not just logistics.

• A poster, not a scroller. Social media is second nature, and you know what makes an event clip worth watching.

• Comfortable behind a camera and in front of people. You can film, run an interview and do basic editing on the fly.

• A strong operator who can run several events in parallel across time zones without dropping quality.

• An excellent communicator who can brief a designer, negotiate with a venue and pitch an executive audience.

• Comfortable with CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

• A willing traveler. You go where the events are and you bring the energy.

Bonus points

• Experience from the insights, market research or MarTech industry. You know the conferences, the audience and the culture.

• Experience at an AI-native research company or a frontier AI or tech company known for its events.

• You’ve built an events function from scratch, including playbooks, processes and measurement.

• You’ve produced a flagship owned event or customer conference.

• A network of event organisers, venues and production partners across Europe and the US.

What we offer

• A fast-scaling, ambitious company where events are a core growth engine, not an afterthought.

• The chance to build GetWhy’s global events function from the ground up and define how a category leader shows up in the world.

• Real ownership, a seat close to leadership, and the budget and trust to try bold ideas.

• Work with some of the world’s most influential brands as customers, speakers and partners.

• Annual company retreats and Friday bar events. We work hard, and we celebrate hard.

How to apply

Click apply and upload your CV, LinkedIn profile, and a link to a portfolio of events you’ve produced. Event photos, clips or social posts you’ve made are a big plus.

If we see a match, we’ll invite you to a conversation online or at our office. The process includes a short creative assignment, where you’ll pitch how GetWhy should show up at one of our key industry conferences.

This isn’t the easiest events job out there. It’s the one that will define how a category leader shows up in the world. Let’s build GetWhy together.

**

**

We’re looking for a hands-on finance leader to own and build our finance function as we scale. You’ll work side by side with our founders and leadership team on strategic decisions, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. This is for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and who wants to have a big impact on how we scale in the future.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**You’ll be a key strategic leader at Pandektes, shaping our current financial setup and optimising it for scale.

We’re looking for a commercially minded finance leader who thrives in high-growth environments and understands what it takes to scale a company from early traction.

You will own and evolve the finance function end-to-end; from building scalable financial infrastructure to partnering closely with our CEO and board on strategic decisions. You’ll combine sharp financial thinking with hands-on execution, ensuring we have the insights, structure, and capital needed to scale responsibly and ambitiously.

As part of the leadership team you’ll play a key role in scaling Pandektes. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both strategic finance and operational execution.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own and evolve Pandektes’ financial strategy, ensuring our financial setup scales with our growth ambitions

• Act as a strategic sparring partner to the CEO and leadership team on company-wide decisions

• Set up and continuously improve operational finance processes, systems, and controls

• Fully own business performance metrics, in particular providing insight into key SaaS indicators to drive business performance, support strategic decision-making and identify opportunities for profitable growth

• Own company-wide budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning

• Work with external partners on accounting, audits, compliance etc.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• Significant experience in high-growth startups or scale-ups, ideally in a VC- or PE-backed environment

• Proven track record leading or playing a central role in fundraising (Series A/B/C and beyond) and/or M&A processes

• Solid understanding of operational finance, including setting up finance functions from scratch or early stage

• Deep experience in excel modelling with a proven track record of delivering automation to manual and complicated processes

• Comfort in dealing with transactional level detail where required in advance of automation and process improvement

• Proven experience with budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn financial data into clear business insights

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

****Full-time

**As Senior Product Development Associate, you'll lead the end-to-end development and delivery of new and improved products across multiple categories, helping mature JOE's global innovation pipeline as it scales. Based at our Global HQ in Copenhagen, the role sits within the Menu & Innovation team, working closely with Brand, Marketing, Operations, Technical, Franchise partners and Supply Chain. Reporting to the Global Menu & Innovation Director, this role manages projects from concept through to launch, ensuring delivery against quality, timings, brand standards, nutritional guardrails, and commercial goals. It combines shaping the global innovation agenda and 3-year menu vision with hands-on ownership of NPD and EPD projects from ideation to in-store launch, always keeping juicer ease at the heart. As part of the team steering JOE's innovation agenda, you'll have real scope to shape the future of our global menu.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own and evolve JOE's NPD and EPD pipeline, leading projects from concept through to launch against timings, budgets and briefs.

• Lead projects from ideation through internal approval, following the internal 'Joe' gate approval process and GreenLight governance.

• Translate concepts into scalable recipes for high-volume execution, developed within brand, quality and operational guardrails, keeping juicer ease at the heart.

• Lead all product testing and trials ahead of launch, including scale-up, product and commercial trials, across appropriate markets worldwide, for your projects.

• Deliver and own a structured calendar of seasonal LTOs and rotating products, aligned with portfolio strategy and commercial priorities.

• Own the innovation pipeline for assigned categories, with full project management ownership of cross-functional teams through the stage-gate process from brief to in-store launch.

• Partner with Operations, Marketing, Supply Chain, Training, Franchise and Compliance to coordinate critical paths and ensure launch readiness.

• Drive communication of product strategy and innovation recommendations to senior leadership, and act as the trend and competitor go-to expert for assigned categories.

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• A defining ability to translate concepts into scalable, operationally sound recipes without losing sight of brand and quality standards.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and seniority levels.

• Strong project management experience, comfortable owning multiple critical paths and timings at once.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• Min. 4 years' experience in a corporate product development role, ideally within QSR (Quick Service Restaurant).

• Hands-on coffee development and product ownership experience.

• Familiarity with stage-gate or gate approval governance is a plus.

• Fluent in English - other languages are a bonus!

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 130 friendly faces come together!

• Enjoy our fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Join us for our lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars-there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Stay fit and healthy with our well-equipped fitness facilities, complete with showers and a relaxing steam room to refresh after your workouts.

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Your Mission

You’ll be the person who makes sure Klimate’s numbers are accurate, on time and a reliable source of truth. As our Finance Manager, you’ll own the books, the close and the reporting, as well as the data behind them. You’ll make sure what goes into our finance reports is correct, traceable and something leadership can rely on.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both finance and data. The foundation is finance: closing the books, reconciling balances and working with our external bookkeepers and auditors. Alongside that, you’ll use SQL, BI and automation, including AI, to validate data across systems, remove manual steps and improve how finance and operations work together. If you like figuring things out and building the solution yourself, there’s a lot of room to do that here.

Finance at Klimate is closely tied to the business. Every contract, credit delivery and supplier payment shows up in the numbers, so you’ll get a front-row view of how the company actually runs. You’ll work side by side with our CFO on strategic matters, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. You’ll have a big impact on how we scale.

About Klimate

At Klimate, we enable companies pursuing real climate action to take responsibility for the emissions they can’t avoid. The world talks a lot about net-zero, but most companies struggle to know what to do once reductions are no longer enough. That’s where we come in. We are a science-led business with real experts guiding companies through the world of carbon removal and how they can safely invest in taking CO₂ out of the atmosphere. Our solution combines expertise, guidance and software to help companies understand what’s real, what works, what it costs, and how to do it credibly.

Founded in 2020, we are a tight-knit team of around 20 people from a great variety of nationalities united by a passion for scaling solutions to the climate crisis. We move quickly when it matters and focus on sharing ownership along the way. Besides working in teams we enable that ownership in squads making it possible for all employees to lead areas, they are passionate about. We value deep collaboration and working side-by-side in our central Copenhagen office, from where we support leading clients including Implement Consulting, Nykredit, Copenhagen Airport and many others.

You can get to know us a bit better on our website or on LinkedIn.

What You'll Do

In your first 3–6 months: keep the numbers right and make the data trustworthy

• Learn Klimate’s commercial and accounting flows from contracts and allocation through invoicing, payments, credit delivery, revenue recognition and balance-sheet treatment.

• Own the month-end and year-end close from start to finish. You’ll work with our external bookkeeper and make sure the final numbers are right, keep payables and receivables on track, follow up on late payments, and support the annual audit.

• Be the quality gate for our external bookkeepers. Give them the right input, check their output, and make sure what reaches the CFO is correct.

• Deliver practical improvements to priority finance/data flows and reporting processes, reducing manual hand-offs and reconciliation where possible. This includes establishing a documented discrepancy-management process.

• Spot the first manual, error-prone steps in our workflows and start fixing them.

• Support with operational and ad hoc tasks that keep the business running smoothly.

From there: build what’s missing and give management the full picture

• Build the dashboards and overviews leadership uses to steer the company, from cash and margins to carbon-credit stock.

• Collaborate closely with the CFO on management reporting. Support budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial planning.

• Decide how new deal types, supplier agreements and carbon-credit purchases should be handled in our accounting, and make sure the treatment holds up at audit.

• Set up and continuously improve our finance processes, systems and controls. Automate wherever it makes sense, using whatever tools fit, AI included.

• Own reliable, traceable datasets and reporting that support finance and cross-functional decisions.

• Lead a prioritised roadmap for improving end-to-end data flows and related processes across finance, purchasing, allocation and stock. Collaborate with technical colleagues on integrations and data-models, including bringing AI-supported automations into our workflows.

Requirements and Skills

Must-haves

• Solid accounting experience, including owning the books for a whole entity, with a strong understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow. You take pride in reconciliations that tie out, and you always trace discrepancies back to their source.

• Experience with the full finance cycle: month-end close, management reporting, annual accounts and working with auditors.

• Advanced Excel modelling skills, practical SQL experience such as writing queries and joining datasets, and a good understanding of BI tools.

• Experience with automating workflows, tasks or reporting, and using AI in practice. You’ve taken manual, complicated processes and made them faster, simpler or automatic.

• Financial analysis skills and the ability to turn data and numbers into clear, evidence-based recommendations.

• Professional English is required. Being able to read and understand Danish is preferred.

Nice-to-have

• Solid knowledge of Danish accounting rules, VAT and statutory reporting requirements.

• Experience from a smaller company, with hands-on internal finance ownership.

Who You Are

• Reliable and trustworthy, with high integrity. You check your own work and make sure the underlying data and the reporting agree.

• Self-driven and you follow through. You see tasks through to completion and ask for input along the way when you need it.

• Energised by a blank page. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy building structure where there isn’t any yet.

• Curious about the business. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do, not just report them.

• A clear communicator. You work well across teams, and you’re not afraid to hold others accountable. You have the judgement to know when to push back, and the pragmatism to find a way that works.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the must have criteria.

What We Offer

Beyond our mission and team culture, we aim to provide a workplace where you can grow professionally and contribute meaningfully to an industry that is rapidly evolving. We offer a competitive compensation package, opportunities to develop your skills, and an environment built on ownership, collaboration and trust.

Benefits

• Vacation: 30 days of paid holiday (5 weeks + 1 week of “feriefridage”).

• Pension & health insurance: Employer-supported pension scheme including health insurance.

• Learning & development: Annual learning budget to support your professional growth.

• Warrants: Eligibility for our warrant program depending on role and seniority.

• Flexibility: We have a weekly work from home day, and offer flexibility in working times and locations as needed.

• Central office location with lunch and great coffee: Cozy office located right next to Nørreport with a catered vegetarian lunch every day and excellent coffee provided by our clients Original Coffee and Prolog.

• Social activities: Weekly wrap up sessions every Friday and a variety of social activities, from foraging and cooking in Amager to trying our hand at pottery.

Start & Logistics

We will review applications on an ongoing basis and hire when we find the right candidate.

Start date: ASAP

Job level (internal scale): Level 8 - Junior Expert (A developing professional who demonstrates potential and aptitude in a specific area of expertise. They possess foundational knowledge and skills, acquired through education, training, and practical experience. Typically guided by a Senior Expert and/or mentor)

What to include in your application

• Please leave out photos and identifying characteristics such as age, gender, nationality, etc.

Our hiring process

• Interview and short assignment or case with CFO + a team member

The final candidate will have:

• Final conversation with our CEO, Mads Emil

• Offer

Equal Opportunities

Klimate is committed to equal opportunities for all people and ideas.

Even if you think you don’t meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply.

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply and strive to ensure an objective selection process.

Our Quality Systems team is looking for a new colleague to strengthen our Supplier Quality Management team at AGC Biologics in Søborg.

Are you interested in supplier quality, GMP compliance and working with internal and external partners in a complex pharmaceutical environment? Do you enjoy working with quality processes, assessments and continuous improvement? Then you may be the colleague we are looking for.

About The Role

As a Supplier Quality Management Specialist, you will join a dedicated team currently consisting of a Scientist and a Senior Scientist. The team supports site manufacturing of clinical and commercial drug substances and is responsible for ensuring that our suppliers meet the required quality standards and regulatory expectations.

You will work with different aspects of Supplier Quality Management, including supplier qualifications, assessments and evaluations, supplier audits, and Supplier Quality Agreements. You will also support the site as a subject matter expert during client audits and regulatory inspections.

We are looking for someone who is interested in supplier management, willing to learn and motivated to contribute to a busy and complex environment. The role requires attention to detail, a pragmatic approach to quality and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

Depending on your experience and qualifications, the position may be filled at Specialist or Senior Specialist level.

Your Responsibilities

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supplier Management: Participate in and manage supplier qualification, assessments and ongoing performance evaluations to ensure suppliers meet AGC Biologics' quality requirements.

• Supplier Audits: Support the planning, preparation and execution of supplier audits. If you are already a trained or certified lead auditor, you may take a leading role in conducting audits. If not, auditor training and development can be part of your development plan.

• Quality Agreements: Prepare, review, negotiate and maintain Supplier Quality Agreements with internal and external partners.

• Audit and Inspection Support: Support the site as a subject matter expert on supplier quality matters during client audits and regulatory inspections.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Material Science, Quality Control, Supply Chain Management and other functional areas at the site, as well as colleagues across AGC's global network.

• Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the development and improvement of supplier quality processes and the site's quality management system.

About The Quality Systems Department

Supplier Quality Management (SQM) is part of the Quality Systems department and plays an important role within the site's Quality organisation.

You will join a diverse team of highly qualified colleagues with extensive experience in Quality Assurance. The team works closely with Material Science,

Quality Control and Supply Chain Management, as well as partners across all functional areas at the site.

We also collaborate with other AGC sites globally to ensure that quality-related activities are carried out effectively, efficiently and in compliance with cGMP requirements.

We value open communication, professionalism and a collaborative approach. Our goal is to provide high-quality support to colleagues across AGC Biologics, our customers and our suppliers.

You will report to the Manager of the Supplier Quality Management team.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a colleague who is detail-oriented, pragmatic and comfortable working with quality requirements in a regulated environment.

As a Person, You Have

• The ability to be pragmatic and still ensure compliance.

• Proven technical writing skills.

• Skills in verbal communications. Ability to respond to complex inquiries from customers, co-workers, and suppliers.

• Skilled in time and priority management.

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively to accomplish deadlines and objectives.

You Also Have

• Minimum 2 years prior working experience in a Biotech/Pharmaceutical environment, with a focus on supplier quality.

• Master’s degree in pharmacy, biochemistry, or related life sciences field.

• Strong knowledge of GMP guidelines, as well as international regulations, pertaining to the production of biopharmaceutical products (including, but not limited to 21 CFR Parts 11, 210, 211, 600, and 610; EU GMP Parts I, II, and III, and relevant ICH guidelines).

• Experienced lead auditor (e.g.: ISO 9001, GMP) is an advantage but not a requirement.

If you do not have lead auditor training or certification, this can be part of your professional development.

What We Offer

At AGC Biologics, you will become part of an international organisation where quality, collaboration and continuous improvement are essential to what we do.

We Offer

• An international working environment with opportunities for professional development and collaboration across global sites.

• Competitive employment conditions, including salary, bonus schemes, pension and health insurance.

• Opportunities for training, development and cross-functional knowledge sharing.

• A strong focus on work-life balance, employee well-being and a supportive working environment.

• A variety of company and Employee Club activities in Copenhagen.

• A flexible and trust-based working culture with an open and collaborative approach.

• The opportunity to contribute to our purpose: Bringing Hope to Life.

How To Apply

Please submit your application and CV through the AGC Biologics career site. We do not accept applications by email.

Deadline: 29 November.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the application deadline if a suitable candidate is identified.

Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Who We Are

AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Do you want to lead 10 engineers building a Legal-Tech SaaS platform on .NET and Azure?

At Epona in Vejle, you will lead the engineering organization behind our Legal-Tech SaaS platform, used by more than 800 law firms and corporate legal departments worldwide. Our platform is built with .NET 10, C#, Azure services, REST APIs and semantic search.

You will combine people leadership with accountability for reliable delivery, engineering quality and continuous improvement, while helping Epona transition from its existing solution to the next-generation SaaS platform.

Your teams

You will be responsible for 10 engineers in Vejle, organized in three teams:

• Two agile product development teams, one working on our new SaaS platform and one on the on-premise solution it replaces

• One platform team of two DevOps engineers, owning CI/CD, infrastructure (Terraform) and cloud operations

How we work with AI

AI is part of how we work, both as product capabilities and as tooling in our engineering workflow. We use Claude as a coding companion to accelerate product delivery and improve quality. We expect you to drive effective and critical use of AI tools across your teams.

Promote responsible AI adoption, including security, code review, testing and appropriate human oversight. Assess its impact on delivery speed, quality and developer effectiveness rather than measuring usage alone.

Your role

As the Head of Engineering, your primary focus is on people leadership and delivering results through your teams. You bring a strong technical background that enables you to challenge technical decisions, contribute to architectural discussions and ensure engineering quality. You report to the CTO.

• Lead, coach and develop 10 engineers through 1:1s, feedback and career development

• Set clear expectations, provide regular performance feedback, address underperformance and develop succession and capability plans.

• Make AI tools like Claude part of how the teams work, and measure the effect on delivery

• Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery with Product Management, including AI-powered capabilities in our platform

• Translate agreed product priorities into realistic engineering commitments; make risks, dependencies, trade-offs and capacity constraints visible early.

• Use relevant indicators such as lead time, delivery predictability, defect trends, reliability and incident resolution to drive improvement, not reporting for its own sake.

• Drive technical direction and engineering quality together with architects and senior engineers

• Strengthen automated testing, security, scalability, maintainability, CI/CD and management of technical debt.

• Collaborate with international colleagues and shape team structure and ways of working across product and platform teams

• Partner with Operations and Support to identify recurring customer issues, reduce avoidable incidents and feed insights into engineering and product improvements.

• Communicate decisions, progress and risks transparently and follow through on agreed actions across teams.

• Own how and how well we deliver, including technical trade-offs and delivery commitments. The Project Manager owns what we deliver and why. Timelines are agreed jointly by trading off scope, time and quality, with escalation to CPO and CTO.

• Stay technically involved through occasional code reviews and technical contributions, while playing a key role in architectural decisions alongside architects and senior engineers. The primary focus remains on leading the engineering teams rather than individual coding.

Measuring success

Success will be measured through improvements in AI adoption and impact, engineering delivery and quality, team engagement and retention, and collaboration with Product Management and Operations.

Within the first 60 days, you will establish baselines and agree measurable 6- and 12-month improvement targets with the CTO.

How you lead – Epona values

Epona’s five values guide how we lead, make decisions and work together. The Engineering Manager is expected to demonstrate them through visible behaviour, not just words.

• One Team — Build a shared identity across Engineering, Product, Operations and Support. Break down silos, actively help colleagues, and put shared outcomes ahead of “them and us” thinking.

• Customer First — Make quality and delivery central to engineering decisions. Understand customer impact, address recurring issues and prioritise reliable outcomes for customers.

• Transparency — Explain the why behind decisions, priorities and trade-offs. Communicate progress, risks and changes openly so teams understand both the direction and the reasoning.

• Responsible — Deliver on promises, take ownership of mistakes, and make responsibilities and follow-up explicit. Combine flexibility and autonomy with clear accountability.

• Respect — Respect cultural differences and individual perspectives. Give feedback respectfully, invite constructive challenge and build an inclusive, supportive team environment.

Tech stack

• Backend and data: .NET 10, C#, MS SQL Server / Azure SQL, Entity Framework Core

• Cloud: Azure (Functions, Web Apps, API Management, Front Door, Entra ID, etc.)

• AI and search: Claude as coding companion, AI-powered product capabilities, Azure AI Search (semantic/vector search)

• DevOps and testing: Azure Pipelines, Terraform, xUnit

• Integrations: SharePoint

What we’re looking for

• 3+ years as an Head of Engineering or Team Lead with direct reports

• A background as a software engineer, preferably in .NET/C# and Azure

• Daily use of AI coding tools, and experience getting a team to adopt them

• Knowledge of how AI features are built and run in production

• Experience building teams that ship SaaS reliably

• Fluent in English (Danish is a plus, not required)

• Proven people leadership, including coaching, performance management and building accountable, collaborative teams.

• Ability to balance technical excellence with business priorities and customer outcomes; communicate trade-offs constructively.

• Nice to have: experience with Terraform and Azure Pipelines, semantic search, SharePoint integrations, Legal-Tech or other regulated industries.

What we offer

• Flexible hybrid setup: 3 days on-site in Vejle, 2 days remote

• Competitive salary matching your experience

• International environment

• Leadership and professional development through sparring, courses and conferences

• An opportunity to shape the next-generation SaaS engineering organisation and its ways of working.

About Epona

Epona is a global Legal-Tech company delivering intelligent document, email and case management solutions built on Microsoft and .NET technology. With offices in the Netherlands, Portugal, USA and Denmark, we serve more than 800 clients worldwide.

How to apply

You can apply via 'Apply' below, but in case you have questions, feel free to reach out to HR via the email address: hr@epona.com.

Application deadline: No fixed deadline. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

Epona is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**The Senior Contract Management Specialist / Senior Contract Counsel (CM) is a key role in the Contract Management team, which is part of Legal & Compliance. The CM supports all SimCorp offerings, including on-premises, SaaS, Professional Services and BPaaS. The CM is responsible for drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing various contracts with clients, as well as providing legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters. The CM also ensures that the contracts are compliant with the law and the business objectives, and that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework.

The CM works closely with the Legal team, Customer Success Management, Service Delivery Management, Project Management Office, and other internal stakeholders to understand the business and technical requirements, and to align the contracts with the best practices and standards of SimCorp. The CM also manages and maintains together with the team the contract repository and the contractual database and supports the further implementation of contract management processes and relevant tools within SimCorp, including the upcoming Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Platform.

The CM will be part of a self-organizing and cross-functional team that delivers value to the clients and the business.

• Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing client contracts, and ensuring that they are aligned with the legal, commercial and technical requirements

• Business partnering through legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters, and resolving contract-related issues and disputes

• Supporting the Customer Success Management, the Service Delivery Managers, the Project Managers, and other internal stakeholders with contract and legal interpretations

• Monitoring and optimizing the commercial performance and quality of the contracts, and collaborating with the business on commercial management

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken

• Experience working in a collaborative team that values teamwork, humor, and good communication

The CM should also have a high level of professionalism and integrity, and a customer-oriented and self-starter mindset

**Benefits

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. **WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

jobs.description:
About Octarine

Octarine Bio is a Copenhagen-based biotech company making safe, sustainable, bio-based pigments. Our PurePalette™ platform uses precision fermentation and renewable raw materials to produce colourants that can replace petrochemical and mined pigments.

We are a team of around 15 people, working across pigment manufacturing, formulation and application development, and commercial development. As our pigment manufacturing processes reach full commercial scale, and our first pigment products are now in the hands of customers and partners, we are looking for someone with deep domain expertise in one or more of our core application areas (dyeing, printing, coatings and plastics) to make PurePalette™ work in real industrial applications and turn successful customer trials into lasting commercial products.

The role

You will be the technical owner of the PurePalette™ product range and the link between our lab and our customers. You will translate what the market needs into clear performance targets, work with our scientists to meet them, and make sure our pigment products perform once they reach a customer's processes.

We are looking for an applications expert in inks and coatings, plastics, or both, or in a closely related pigment application field. The title and scope will match your experience:

• Technical Product Specialist if you are earlier in your career and want a role with a lot of room to grow as the company scales.

• Head of Product Development if you have the experience to lead the product and applications function, shape the product roadmap and build a team.

In both cases you will report directly to our Chief Scientific Officer and work closely with our commercial team.

What you will do

Own the product, technically

• Be the technical expert for all PurePalette™ products and the first point of contact for technical questions from customers, partners and colleagues.

• Define the performance and quality parameters customers expect in each application, such as colour strength, dispersibility, heat stability, light and weather fastness, migration, rheology, and wash and rub fastness.

• Plan and coordinate the internal and external testing needed to prove each parameter, and turn the results into clear data packages for customers.

• Own, write and maintain our technical and product documentation, including Safety Data Sheets (SDS), Technical Data Sheets (TDS), Certificates of Analysis (CoA), product specifications and application guides.

Make our pigments work for customers

• Work with customers, distributors and partners to implement PurePalette™ products in their processes, from first lab trial to production run.

• Own the technical side of our partnerships with masterbatchers, ink manufacturers, dyehouses and research institutes. Set up project plans, manage technology transfer between parties, and troubleshoot problems until the product works in the target application.

• Handle technical customer feedback and complaints, find the root cause and feed lessons back into product and process development.

Decide what to develop next

• Identify where bio-based pigments offer real value to end users, and where they can genuinely meet customers' performance expectations.

• Work with Octarine scientists to map which applications our current pigments suit, and which applications we should target with future products.

• Work with our formulation and application scientists to refine formulations (dispersions, masterbatches, inks, dye and print pastes) to meet customer requirements.

• Work with our R&D and process teams to develop and implement strategies that improve pigment performance, for example through stabilisation, surface treatment or particle engineering.

• Benchmark our products against incumbent pigments and competing bio-based alternatives.

Connect technical and commercial

• Act as the bridge between Octarine's technical and commercial teams, translating customer needs into technical requirements and technical results into customer value.

• Join customer meetings, site visits and trade fairs as the technical voice of the company.

• Contribute technical content to sales materials, grant applications and investor discussions, and help capture new inventions for our IP portfolio.

What you bring

Pigment applications are many markets, not one. Printing inks alone span flexo, gravure, offset, screen and digital printing, and each places different demands on a pigment. The end markets differ just as much, from packaging and textiles to toys, consumer goods and coatings, each with its own performance, safety and regulatory requirements.

We need someone who knows this landscape in depth. You should understand the technical and performance requirements of each sub-application and market, judge where our pigments have a realistic and valuable fit, and work with our scientists to develop products that meet those requirements.

Specifically, we are looking for:

• An MSc or PhD in chemistry, polymer or materials science, chemical engineering, colour science or a related field, or equivalent industrial experience.

• Hands-on industrial experience applying pigments or colourants in textiles, inks and coatings, plastics and masterbatch, or a closely related field. For the Head of Product Development level, we expect around 5 or more years, including leading projects or people.

• A practical understanding of pigment dispersion and of how pigment properties such as particle size, surface chemistry and thermal stability affect performance in the final product.

• Experience with colour measurement (spectrophotometry, CIELAB, ΔE) and with standard ISO, EN or ASTM test methods for pigment and application performance.

• Experience writing or maintaining SDS, TDS and CoA documents, and working knowledge of REACH and CLP.

• Experience working directly with customers or external partners on trials, scale-up or technology transfer.

• The ability to explain technical results clearly to scientists, customers and commercial colleagues.

• A structured, self-driven way of working, and comfort with the pace and ambiguity of an early-stage company.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

• The confidence to take full ownership of the role from day one. You will set your own priorities, make decisions within your remit and drive projects to completion without close supervision, keeping the CSO informed rather than waiting for direction.

Nice to have

• Experience in both inks and coatings and plastics.

• Experience with textile dyeing or printing.

• Experience with organic pigments, natural colourants or other bio-based materials.

• Knowledge of food contact and product safety requirements, such as EU 10/2011, the Swiss Ordinance, EuPIA guidelines, EN 71-3 or ZDHC.

• Experience with quality systems such as ISO 9001, or with setting product specifications for a new product.

• An existing network in the European ink, coatings, masterbatch or textile industries.

What we offer

• A central role in bringing a new class of sustainable pigments to market, with real influence over which products we build and how.

• Direct work with the founding team and a short path from idea to decision.

• A small, highly skilled team of scientists across synthetic biology, fermentation, downstream processing, formulation and application.

• For earlier-career candidates, a role that can grow with the company. For senior candidates, the chance to build and lead the product function.

• Real autonomy and ownership of your work, and the chance to make a lasting impact at a fast-growing company developing new materials for industries that urgently need to change.

Practical details

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark. On-site is strongly preferred; hybrid working is possible for the right candidate.

Start date: As soon as possible

Reports to: Chief Scientific Officer

Employment: Full-time, permanent

Travel: Some travel to customers and partners within Europe

Right to work: Applicants must already have the right to live and work in Denmark. We are unfortunately not able to sponsor work visas at this time.

How to apply

Apply with your CV. Please highlight the pigment applications you have worked on and a technical problem you solved in a customer's process.

We review applications on a rolling basis and will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply early.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are happy to answer questions about the role before you apply.
